title: Ring
description: One stage of a rollout: its hosts, its soak time, the release they run and its security floor. A release enters a ring only after it ran healthy in the ring before it for that ring's soak time. A release below the floor would open the advisories that the floor release fixed again, so a rollback below it needs a named approver.

position.description: The place of the ring in the rollout order, from 0.

release.description: The release that the ring's hosts run.

floor.title: RingFloor
floor.description: The lowest release that the ring may run, and why.
